what_happened.line: The Select Board agreed to run reference checks on four town counsel firms before inviting any of them back for a second round.
One member agreed to make the reference calls, and other members will send her their questions.
The board interviewed two more town counsel firms, the last of nine heard that night.
One candidate firm offered several hours a month at no charge to meet with officials and boards, and said it has fee proposals meant to ease worry about cost.
Members ranked all nine firms and compared their lists before choosing the four finalists. No votes were taken.

why_it_matters: Town counsel advises the town on legal questions and is paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, so the fee structure the board picks affects what legal advice costs the town.
The choice is still open: four firms remain, and none has been named or hired.
watch_next: Results of the reference checks on the four firms, and which firms the board invites back.
